steps.title: A pawn is cheap
steps.body: A pawn that attacks two pieces wins one of them for almost nothing. Look for pawn moves that hit two things at once.
The pawn on e4 can step to e5. From e5 it attacks the knights on d6 and f6, and neither knight can capture it.

steps.q: Why is a pawn fork strong?
options: A pawn is worth less than the pieces it attacks
steps.why: They must lose a piece for a pawn.

cards.prompt: What makes a pawn fork strong?
solution: The pawn is worth less than the targets.
